scope: Rescan the original source without reimporting or replacing a teacher's saved work

implementation.migration: 012_source_checks.sql adds scan jobs and a private source-job lookup index
implementation.api: Owned GET/HEAD metadata and POST command at /api/ktp/{id}/source; no storage key or checksum returned
implementation.admission: UUID idempotency keys, one active job per source, owner lock plus upload lock, at most five newly queued source checks per owner per hour
implementation.worker: Normal inspection, immutable publication and lease fencing, followed by scan-only completion before parsing or any plan-version update
implementation.preservation: Plan rows, revision, confirmed status, generation document/revision and teacher approval remain intact
implementation.ui: Main interface polls only while checking; Lite has a separate file-status refresh, cancellation, retry through a new bounded command and a working source link after success
implementation.failure: Damaged-source errors recommend safe reupload; temporary failures allow retry; existing unsafe-download gates remain active
implementation.routing: Source endpoint explicitly rejects extra path segments and unsupported methods; only its exact metadata path receives the lightweight read budget

verification.relatedIntegrationSuite: 15 passed against PostgreSQL, private S3, renderer, ClamAV and the running worker
verification.finalTargetedChromium: Six passed on the final API/UI image, including method/path guards, failed check and deletion
verification.finalTargetedWebkit: Two UI cases passed: main and Lite preserve unsaved lessons through cancellation and successful rescan
verification.approvalAssertion: The parallel/idempotency case also passed with an explicit unchanged generation-revision assertion
verification.responsiveAndAccessibility: Main and Lite checked at 360 px in light/dark themes with axe; inspected rendered panels and corrected Lite spacing
verification.recovery: 17 real PostgreSQL scenarios, including exhausted, requeued and cancelled scan jobs preserving confirmed plan status
verification.backupRestore: All 21 public tables and 12 migrations restored with matching consistent-snapshot hashes
verification.build: Production web and worker Docker images built and started; lint, typecheck and source checks passed
verification.externalCalls: No paid AI requests or public deployment in this batch

limits: Production rollout must replace all pre-scan worker versions before enabling the new API/UI; rollback rules are documented in runbook
Already-running external scanning may finish after cancellation, but lease/cancellation checks prevent unauthorized publication
Lite intentionally uses a manual status refresh rather than idle background polling
These checks do not replace cloud acceptance, a sustained load test, a physical Windows 7 test or pedagogical review
Fresh vulnerability scans of the exact release image digests and the latest remote CI completion remain separate release gates
